title: Object clauses with that · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: An object clause serves as the object of a verb like say/think/know/believe; the word order must be statement order.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。
points: that can be omitted
the object clause must use statement word order: I think that he is right
the negative transfer of think: I don't think he is right
the tense follows the main clause
when the main clause is in the past, the clause moves back one tense

examples.en: I think that the movie is wonderful.
examples.zh: 我觉得这部电影很精彩。

examples.en: She said that she would come the next day.
examples.zh: 她说她第二天会来。

examples.en: We know that the earth goes around the sun.
examples.zh: 我们知道地球绕着太阳转。

examples.en: He believes that practice makes perfect.
examples.zh: 他相信熟能生巧。

examples.en: I don't think that he is right.
examples.zh: 我认为他不对。

examples.en: The teacher said that light travels faster than sound.
examples.zh: 老师说光比声音传播得快。

questions.prompt: I think that the movie _____ wonderful.
options: is
be
are
does
questions.explanation: 考查that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。此处应为 is。句意:我觉得这部电影很精彩。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She said that she would come the next day.
She said that she will come the next day.
She said that she comes the next day.
She said that she would came the next day.
questions.explanation: that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。正确句:She said that she would come the next day.

questions.prompt: 「我们知道地球绕着太阳转。」的正确英文是?
options: We know that the earth does go around the sun.
We know that the earth went around the sun.
We know that the earth go around the sun.
We know that the earth goes around the sun.
questions.explanation: 考查that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。正确句:We know that the earth goes around the sun.

questions.prompt: He believes that practice _____ perfect.
options: makes
does make
made
make
questions.explanation: 考查that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。此处应为 makes。句意:他相信熟能生巧。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I don't think that he does right.
I don't think that is he right.
I don't think that he is right.
I don't think that he right is.
questions.explanation: that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。正确句:I don't think that he is right.

questions.prompt: 「老师说光比声音传播得快。」的正确英文是?
options: The teacher said that light travelled faster than sound.
The teacher said that light travel faster than sound.
The teacher said that light does travel faster than sound.
The teacher said that light travels faster than sound.
questions.explanation: 考查that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。正确句:The teacher said that light travels faster than sound.

title: Object clauses with if / whether and question words · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: if/whether and special question words introduce object clauses; the key exam point is word order.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。
points: if/whether means 'whether'
special question words (what/where/when/how) keep their original meaning
the clause uses statement word order: where he lives
the tense follows the main clause
the expression for polite requests: Could you tell me how to get to...

examples.en: I don't know whether he will come.
examples.zh: 我不知道他是否会来。

examples.en: Do you know where the station is?
examples.zh: 你知道车站在哪儿吗?

examples.en: She asked what time it was.
examples.zh: 她问现在几点了。

examples.en: Nobody knows why he left so early.
examples.zh: 没人知道他为什么走这么早。

examples.en: Could you tell me how I can get to the supermarket?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我怎么去超市吗?

examples.en: I wonder if the shop is open now.
examples.zh: 我想知道商店现在是否开门。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I don't know whether will he come.
I don't know whether does he come.
I don't know whether he comes will.
I don't know whether he will come.
questions.explanation: Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。正确句:I don't know whether he will come.

questions.prompt: 「你知道车站在哪儿吗?」的正确英文是?
options: Do you know where does the station?
Do you know where the station does?
Do you know where the station is?
Do you know where is the station?
questions.explanation: 考查Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。正确句:Do you know where the station is?

options: what is time it
what time it was

what time was it
questions.explanation: 考查Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。此处应为 what time it was。句意:她问现在几点了。

questions.explanation: Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。正确句:Nobody knows why he left so early.

options: Could you tell me how I get can to the supermarket?
Could you tell me how can I get to the supermarket?
Could you tell me how I can get to the supermarket?
Could you tell me how do I get to the supermarket?
questions.explanation: 考查Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。正确句:Could you tell me how I can get to the supermarket?

options: the shop if is
if does the shop
if is the shop
if the shop is
questions.explanation: 考查Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。此处应为 if the shop is。句意:我想知道商店现在是否开门。

title: Adverbial clauses of time with when / before / after · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: A time adverbial clause introduced by when/before/after/as soon as; the future is expressed with the present.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。
points: when + point in time
before = before, after = after
main clause future, subordinate clause present
as soon as = as soon as
while + continuous action

examples.en: I will call you when I get home.
examples.zh: 我到家后会给你打电话。

examples.en: Turn off the lights before you leave.
examples.zh: 离开前关灯。

examples.en: After she finishes her homework, she watches TV.
examples.zh: 她做完作业后看电视。

examples.en: As soon as the rain stops, we will go out.
examples.zh: 雨一停我们就出去。

examples.en: When spring comes, the flowers come out.
examples.zh: 春天来临时花就开了。

examples.en: I must finish the work before he comes back.
examples.zh: 我必须在他回来前完成工作。

questions.prompt: 「我到家后会给你打电话。」的正确英文是?
options: I will call you when I get home.
I will call you when I am getting home.
I will call you when I will get home.
I will call you when I got home.
questions.explanation: 考查The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。正确句:I will call you when I get home.

questions.prompt: Turn off the lights before you _____.
options: are leaving
will leave
leave
left
questions.explanation: 考查The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。此处应为 leave。句意:离开前关灯。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: After she will finish her homework, she watches TV.
After she finishes her homework, she watches TV.
After she finished her homework, she watches TV.
After she is finishing her homework, she watches TV.
questions.explanation: The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。正确句:After she finishes her homework, she watches TV.

questions.prompt: 「雨一停我们就出去。」的正确英文是?
options: As soon as the rain stopped, we will go out.
As soon as the rain stops, we will go out.
As soon as the rain is stopping, we will go out.
As soon as the rain will stop, we will go out.
questions.explanation: 考查The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。正确句:As soon as the rain stops, we will go out.

questions.prompt: When spring _____, the flowers come out.
options: will come
is coming
came
comes
questions.explanation: 考查The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。此处应为 comes。句意:春天来临时花就开了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I must finish the work before he came back.
I must finish the work before he comes back.
I must finish the work before he is coming back.
I must finish the work before he will come back.
questions.explanation: The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。正确句:I must finish the work before he comes back.

title: First conditional if...will · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: First conditional: if + present, main clause will + base verb, expressing a real future possibility.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。
points: if + subject + present
main clause subject + will + base verb
the subordinate clause cannot use will
the if clause can come before or after
unless = if...not

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨,我们就待在家里。

examples.en: We will miss the train if we are late.
examples.zh: 如果迟到我们就赶不上火车了。

examples.en: If you work hard, you will pass the exam.
examples.zh: 如果你努力学习,就会通过考试。

examples.en: She will help you if you ask her.
examples.zh: 如果你请她帮忙,她会帮你。

examples.en: If we plant more trees, the city will be greener.
examples.zh: 如果我们种更多的树,城市会更绿。

examples.en: You will feel better if you take a rest.
examples.zh: 如果你休息一下,会感觉好一些。

questions.prompt: If it _____ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
options: will rain
rained
is raining
rains
questions.explanation: 考查If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。此处应为 rains。句意:如果明天下雨,我们就待在家里。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We will miss the train if we are late.
We will miss the train if we will be late.
We will miss the train if we were late.
We will miss the train if we would be late.
questions.explanation: If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。正确句:We will miss the train if we are late.

questions.prompt: 「如果你努力学习,就会通过考试。」的正确英文是?
options: If you work hard, you passed the exam.
If you work hard, you would pass the exam.
If you work hard, you will pass the exam.
If you work hard, you pass the exam.
questions.explanation: 考查If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。正确句:If you work hard, you will pass the exam.

options: ask
would ask
asked

questions.explanation: 考查If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。此处应为 ask。句意:如果你请她帮忙,她会帮你。

options: If we will plant more trees, the city will be greener.
If we plant more trees, the city will be greener.
If we would plant more trees, the city will be greener.
If we planted more trees, the city will be greener.
questions.explanation: If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。正确句:If we plant more trees, the city will be greener.

questions.prompt: 「如果你休息一下,会感觉好一些。」的正确英文是?

You will feel better if you will take a rest.

You will feel better if you took a rest.
questions.explanation: 考查If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。正确句:You will feel better if you take a rest.

title: Adverbial clauses of reason with because / since / as · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: Reason adverbial clauses: because is strongest, since/as introduce reasons both sides already know.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。
points: because answers why, strongest tone
since = since, based on a known fact
as = as, weakest tone
now that = since
when because is used, so is not used in the main clause

examples.en: Since everyone is here, let's begin the class.
examples.zh: 既然大家都到了,我们开始上课吧。

examples.en: He didn't go to school because he was ill.
examples.zh: 他因为生病没去上学。

examples.en: As it is late, we'd better take a taxi.
examples.zh: 由于天晚了,我们最好打车。

examples.en: Now that the work is done, you can rest.
examples.zh: 既然工作做完了,你可以休息了。

examples.en: I stayed because the meeting was long.
examples.zh: 因为会议很长,我留下来了。

examples.en: Since you know the answer, please tell us.
examples.zh: 既然你知道答案,请告诉我们。

Because of everyone is here, let's begin the class.

questions.prompt: 「他因为生病没去上学。」的正确英文是?
options: He didn't go to school because of he was ill.
He didn't go to school as for he was ill.
He didn't go to school so he was ill.
He didn't go to school because he was ill.
questions.explanation: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:He didn't go to school because he was ill.

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Now what the work is done, you can rest.

questions.explanation: because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:Now that the work is done, you can rest.

questions.prompt: 「因为会议很长,我留下来了。」的正确英文是?

I stayed because the meeting was long.

questions.prompt: _____ you know the answer, please tell us.

Because of
Since
For
questions.explanation: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。此处应为 Since。句意:既然你知道答案,请告诉我们。

title: Adverbial clauses of concession with although / though · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: although/though introduces a concession: cannot be used together with but.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。
points: although = though, placed at the start
the main clause cannot use but, but can use yet/still
even though has a stronger tone
though can appear at the end of a sentence
despite/in spite of + noun also express concession

examples.en: Although it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
examples.zh: 虽然天很冷,我们旅行得很愉快。

examples.en: Though he is young, he knows a lot.
examples.zh: 虽然他年纪小,但懂得很多。

examples.zh: 虽然她很累,仍继续工作。

examples.en: Even though the task was hard, we finished it.
examples.zh: 尽管任务很难,我们还是完成了。

examples.en: He passed the exam though he was ill.
examples.zh: 虽然生病了,他还是通过了考试。

examples.en: Although the shop is small, it has everything.
examples.zh: 这家店虽然小,但什么都有。

Although it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.

questions.prompt: _____ he is young, he knows a lot.
options: Despite
Even
Though
Though but
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。此处应为 Though。句意:虽然他年纪小,但懂得很多。

Even though the task was hard, we finished it.
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Even though the task was hard, we finished it.

questions.prompt: He passed the exam _____ he was ill.

but
despite
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。此处应为 though。句意:虽然生病了,他还是通过了考试。

options: Despite the shop is small, it has everything.
Although but the shop is small, it has everything.
Although the shop is small, it has everything.
However the shop is small, it has everything.
questions.explanation: although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Although the shop is small, it has everything.

title: Adverbials of purpose with to / in order to · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: Adverbials of purpose express purpose: to/in order to + base verb, so that + clause.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。
points: to + base verb is the most common
in order to emphasizes purpose
so as to / in order to can be placed at the start
so that + subject + can/may + base verb
in order not to / so as not to express a negative purpose

examples.en: I got up early to catch the first bus.
examples.zh: 我早起是为了赶上头班车。

to catching
catch

I wrote it down for not forget.
I wrote it down in order not to forget.
I wrote it down so that not to forget.
questions.explanation: to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:I wrote it down in order not to forget.

They plant trees for make the city greener.

They plant trees make the city greener.

title: Infinitives as object want to do · 易错辨析(第4轮)

hope to do / plan to do / agree to do

questions.prompt: We hope _____ Toronto next year.

visit

questions.prompt: 「他答应帮我学音乐。」的正确英文是?
options: He promised help me with music.

title: Gerunds as object enjoy doing · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: Verbs like enjoy, finish, practice, mind, keep are followed by the gerund as object.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。
points: enjoy doing = enjoy something
finish doing = finish doing something
practice doing / keep doing
mind doing (used in questions)
stop doing stops the current action; stop to do stops in order to do something else

They stopped to talk when the teacher came in.

title: Gerunds after prepositions · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: A verb after a preposition takes the gerund: at/in/on/of/for/about + V-ing.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。
points: be good at + V-ing
be interested in + V-ing
instead of + V-ing
look forward to + V-ing (to is a preposition)
before/after + V-ing as object

examples.en: She is good at drawing pictures.
examples.zh: 她擅长画画。

examples.en: I am interested in learning math.
examples.zh: 我对学数学感兴趣。

examples.en: He went out instead of doing homework.
examples.zh: 他没有做作业,而是出去了。

examples.en: We look forward to seeing you again.
examples.zh: 我们期待再见到你。

examples.en: Wash your hands before eating.
examples.zh: 饭前要洗手。

examples.en: Thank you for helping me with the work.
examples.zh: 谢谢你帮我做这项工作。

questions.prompt: She is good at _____ pictures.
options: drawing
to draw
draw
draws
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。此处应为 drawing。句意:她擅长画画。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I am interested in to learn math.
I am interested in learns math.
I am interested in learn math.
I am interested in learning math.
questions.explanation: Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:I am interested in learning math.

options: He went out instead of doing homework.

He went out instead of do homework.
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:He went out instead of doing homework.

questions.prompt: We look forward to _____ you again.
options: seeing
to see
sees
see
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。此处应为 seeing。句意:我们期待再见到你。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Wash your hands before eat.
Wash your hands before eats.
Wash your hands before to eat.
Wash your hands before eating.
questions.explanation: Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:Wash your hands before eating.

questions.prompt: 「谢谢你帮我做这项工作。」的正确英文是?
options: Thank you for helps me with the work.
Thank you for help me with the work.
Thank you for to help me with the work.
Thank you for helping me with the work.
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:Thank you for helping me with the work.

title: so...that / too...to / enough to · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: Three result structures: so...that, too...to (negative meaning), enough to (affirmative meaning).本课为易错辨析练习,核心:so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。
points: so + adjective/adorb + that clause
too + adjective + to do = too...to
adjective + enough + to do = enough to...
so that can also express purpose
such + noun phrase + that, distinguished from so

examples.en: The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.
examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了,我搬不动。

examples.en: He is too young to drive a car.
examples.zh: 他太年轻,不能开车。

examples.en: She is old enough to go to school.
examples.zh: 她到上学的年龄了。

examples.en: The question was so difficult that nobody answered it.
examples.zh: 这道题太难了,没人答出来。

examples.en: It is such an interesting book that I read it twice.
examples.zh: 这本书如此有趣,我读了两遍。

examples.en: He ran fast enough to catch the bus.
examples.zh: 他跑得够快,赶上了公交车。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.
The box is heavy so that I can't carry it.
The box is such heavy that I can't carry it.
The box is too heavy that that I can't carry it.
questions.explanation: so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.

questions.prompt: 「他太年轻,不能开车。」的正确英文是?
options: He is such young to drive a car.
He is so young to drive a car.
He is young enough to drive a car.
He is too young to drive a car.
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:He is too young to drive a car.

questions.prompt: She is _____ to go to school.
options: so old
old enough
enough old
too old
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。此处应为 old enough。句意:她到上学的年龄了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The question was such difficult that nobody answered it.
The question was too difficult that that nobody answered it.
The question was difficult so that nobody answered it.
The question was so difficult that nobody answered it.
questions.explanation: so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:The question was so difficult that nobody answered it.

questions.prompt: 「这本书如此有趣,我读了两遍。」的正确英文是?
options: It is such an interesting book that I read it twice.
It is very an interesting book that I read it twice.
It is too an interesting book that I read it twice.
It is so an interesting book that I read it twice.
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:It is such an interesting book that I read it twice.

questions.prompt: He ran _____ to catch the bus.
options: enough fast
fast enough
so fast
too fast
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。此处应为 fast enough。句意:他跑得够快,赶上了公交车。

title: Tag questions · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: Tag questions: front affirmative, tag negative, and vice versa; reuse the be/auxiliary/modal of the main clause.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。
points: front affirmative, tag negative
front negative, tag affirmative
the tag uses the be/auxiliary/modal of the main clause
Let's..., shall we?
an imperative sentence uses will you

examples.en: You are a student, aren't you?
examples.zh: 你是学生,不是吗?

examples.en: She doesn't like salad, does she?
examples.zh: 她不喜欢沙拉,对吗?

examples.en: They went to the gym yesterday, didn't they?
examples.zh: 他们昨天去了健身房,不是吗?

examples.en: He can swim well, can't he?
examples.zh: 他游泳游得很好,不是吗?

examples.en: Let's take a walk after dinner, shall we?
examples.zh: 晚饭后我们散散步,好吗?

examples.en: Close the door, will you?
examples.zh: 把门关上,好吗?

questions.prompt: 「你是学生,不是吗?」的正确英文是?
options: You are a student, don't you?
You are a student, aren't you?
You are a student, isn't you?
You are a student, are you?
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:You are a student, aren't you?

questions.prompt: She doesn't like salad, _____?
options: doesn't she
is she
did she
does she
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。此处应为 does she。句意:她不喜欢沙拉,对吗?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: They went to the gym yesterday, didn't they?
They went to the gym yesterday, weren't they?
They went to the gym yesterday, don't they?
They went to the gym yesterday, did they?
questions.explanation: Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:They went to the gym yesterday, didn't they?

questions.prompt: 「他游泳游得很好,不是吗?」的正确英文是?
options: He can swim well, isn't he?
He can swim well, can't he?
He can swim well, can he?
He can swim well, does he?
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:He can swim well, can't he?

questions.prompt: Let's take a walk after dinner, _____?
options: do we
will we
shall we
shant we
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。此处应为 shall we。句意:晚饭后我们散散步,好吗?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Close the door, shall you?
Close the door, do you?
Close the door, won't I?
Close the door, will you?
questions.explanation: Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:Close the door, will you?

title: Exclamatory sentences What / How · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: Exclamatory sentences start with What or How: What a/an + adjective + singular noun; How + adjective.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。
points: What a/an + adjective + singular noun
What + adjective + plural noun
How + adjective/adorb + subject + verb
the exclamatory word must be placed before the phrase it modifies
an exclamatory sentence can omit the subject and verb

examples.zh: 多么美好的一天啊!

examples.zh: 多么好的消息啊!

options: How a
What a
How
What

options: How lovely flowers they are!

options: What a fast he runs!

How time flies!

questions.explanation: What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:How time flies!

questions.prompt: 「多么好的消息啊!」的正确英文是?
options: How a good news it is!
What good news it is!
What a good news it is!
How good news it is!
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:What good news it is!

title: both / either / neither · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: both/either/neither express the quantity relationships of two objects; mind singular and plural agreement.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。
points: both...and... connects two parallel parts
neither...nor... neither...nor...
either...or... either...or...
both of them are / neither of them is
the subject connected by either...or agrees with the nearer one (proximity principle)

examples.zh: 我的父母都喜欢旅行。

examples.en: Neither of the answers is right.

examples.en: Both Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
examples.zh: 莉莉和汤姆都在二班。

examples.zh: 要么你要么他得打扫教室。

options: Neither of the answers were right.

Neither of the answers is right.

questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Neither of the answers is right.

either
all
both
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。此处应为 either。句意:这两本书你可以拿任意一本。

options: Neither Tom nor his sister is being at home.
Neither Tom nor his sister was at home.
Neither Tom nor his sister were at home.
Neither Tom nor his sister are at home.
questions.explanation: both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Neither Tom nor his sister was at home.

questions.prompt: 「莉莉和汤姆都在二班。」的正确英文是?
options: All Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
Neither Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
Both Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
Either Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Both Lily and Tom are in Class 2.

questions.prompt: Either you or he _____ to clean the classroom.
options: are
has
have
having
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。此处应为 has。句意:要么你要么他得打扫教室。

title: used to past habits · 易错辨析(第4轮)

points: used to + base verb
the negative is didn't use to / used not to
the question is Did...use to...?
be used to + V-ing = accustomed to (different meaning)
often contrasted with now

He used to playing baseball after school.
He use to play baseball after school.
He was used to play baseball after school.
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:He used to play baseball after school.

use to be

used to be

options: She didn't used to like bread.
She didn't using to like bread.

questions.explanation: used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:She didn't use to like bread.

questions.prompt: 「我现在习惯早起。」的正确英文是?

I am used to get up early now.
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:I am used to getting up early now.

questions.prompt: Did you _____ live in Chengdu?

used
used to
using to
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。此处应为 use to。句意:你过去住在成都吗?

We use to walk to school together.

title: as...as comparisons · 易错辨析(第4轮)

the negative is not as/so + adjective + as
the same...as = the same as
as...as possible = as...as possible

as tall as
as taller as

title: Present perfect have/has + past participle · 情景运用(第4轮)
summary: have/has + past participle expresses an action that happened in the past and its impact on the present.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。
points: have/has + past participle
often with already, yet, just, ever, never
the negative is haven't/hasn't + past participle
Have you ever...? asks about experience
distinguish from the past simple: no specific past time is given

examples.en: I have finished my homework already.
examples.zh: 我已经完成了作业。

examples.en: She has lived here for ten years.
examples.zh: 她在这里住了十年了。

examples.en: He hasn't seen this movie yet.
examples.zh: 他还没看过这部电影。

examples.en: We have known each other since 2018.

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I finished have my homework already.
I have finished my homework already.
I has finished my homework already.
I have finish my homework already.
questions.explanation: Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。正确句:I have finished my homework already.

questions.prompt: 「她在这里住了十年了。」的正确英文是?
options: She have lived here for ten years.
She lived has here for ten years.
She has live here for ten years.

the verb in the clause agrees with the antecedent

title: Relative clauses which / that (things) · 情景运用(第4轮)

points: where modifies a place antecedent: the school where I study
when modifies a time antecedent: the day when we met
where can be rewritten as prep + which
when can be rewritten as on/in which
why modifies the antecedent reason

points: that can be omitted
the object clause must use statement word order: I think that he is right
the negative transfer of think: I don't think he is right
the tense follows the main clause
when the main clause is in the past, the clause moves back one tense

examples.zh: 虽然他年纪小,但懂得很多。

examples.en: Although she was tired, she kept working.
examples.zh: 虽然她很累,仍继续工作。

examples.en: Even though the task was hard, we finished it.

examples.en: He passed the exam though he was ill.

examples.en: Although the shop is small, it has everything.

questions.prompt: _____ it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
options: Despite
Although but
Even
Although
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。此处应为 Although。句意:虽然天很冷,我们旅行得很愉快。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Even he is young, he knows a lot.
Though he is young, he knows a lot.
Despite he is young, he knows a lot.
Though but he is young, he knows a lot.
questions.explanation: although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Though he is young, he knows a lot.

questions.prompt: 「虽然她很累,仍继续工作。」的正确英文是?
options: Although she was tired, she but kept working.
Although she was tired, she kept working.
Although she was tired, she was keeping working.
Although she was tired, she keeps working.
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Although she was tired, she kept working.

questions.prompt: _____ the task was hard, we finished it.
options: Despite
Although but
Even though
Even
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。此处应为 Even though。句意:尽管任务很难,我们还是完成了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He passed the exam however he was ill.
He passed the exam but he was ill.
He passed the exam though he was ill.
He passed the exam despite he was ill.
questions.explanation: although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:He passed the exam though he was ill.

questions.prompt: 「这家店虽然小,但什么都有。」的正确英文是?
options: Despite the shop is small, it has everything.
Although the shop is small, it has everything.
However the shop is small, it has everything.
Although but the shop is small, it has everything.
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Although the shop is small, it has everything.

title: Adverbials of purpose with to / in order to · 情景运用(第4轮)
summary: Adverbials of purpose express purpose: to/in order to + base verb, so that + clause.本课为情景运用练习,核心:to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。
points: to + base verb is the most common
in order to emphasizes purpose
so as to / in order to can be placed at the start
so that + subject + can/may + base verb
in order not to / so as not to express a negative purpose

examples.en: I got up early to catch the first bus.
examples.zh: 我早起是为了赶上头班车。

examples.en: She studies hard in order to go to college.
examples.zh: 她努力学习是为了上大学。

examples.en: We speak slowly so that everyone can follow.
examples.zh: 我们说得慢,好让每个人都能跟上。

examples.en: He saved money to buy a new bike.
examples.zh: 他攒钱是为了买一辆新自行车。

examples.en: I wrote it down in order not to forget.
examples.zh: 我记下来是为了不忘记。

examples.en: They plant trees to make the city greener.
examples.zh: 他们种树是为了让城市更绿。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I got up early catch the first bus.
I got up early to catch the first bus.
I got up early for catch the first bus.
I got up early to catching the first bus.
questions.explanation: to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:I got up early to catch the first bus.

questions.prompt: 「她努力学习是为了上大学。」的正确英文是?
options: She studies hard for go to college.
She studies hard in order to go to college.
She studies hard in order that to go to college.
She studies hard so as go to college.
questions.explanation: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:She studies hard in order to go to college.

questions.prompt: We speak slowly _____ everyone can follow.
options: in order
so that
because
so as
questions.explanation: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。此处应为 so that。句意:我们说得慢,好让每个人都能跟上。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He saved money buy a new bike.
He saved money to buy a new bike.
He saved money to buying a new bike.
He saved money for buy a new bike.
questions.explanation: to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:He saved money to buy a new bike.

questions.prompt: 「我记下来是为了不忘记。」的正确英文是?
options: I wrote it down for not forget.
I wrote it down in order not to forget.
I wrote it down in order to not forget.
I wrote it down so that not to forget.
questions.explanation: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:I wrote it down in order not to forget.

questions.prompt: They plant trees _____ the city greener.
options: to make
make
to making
for make
questions.explanation: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。此处应为 to make。句意:他们种树是为了让城市更绿。

title: Infinitives as object want to do · 情景运用(第4轮)
summary: Verbs like want, decide, hope, plan, promise are followed by the infinitive as object.本课为情景运用练习,核心:want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。
points: want to do = want to do something
decide to do = decide to do something
hope to do / plan to do / agree to do
would like to do expresses a polite wish
enjoy/finish/mind take V-ing instead

examples.en: I want to buy a new dictionary.
examples.zh: 我想买一本新词典。

examples.en: She decided to learn English by herself.
examples.zh: 她决定自学英语。

examples.en: We hope to visit Xi'an next year.
examples.zh: 我们希望明年去西安。

examples.en: They plan to build a small garden.
examples.zh: 他们计划建一个小花园。

examples.en: He promised to help me with art.
examples.zh: 他答应帮我学美术。

examples.en: Would you like to join our club?
examples.zh: 你愿意加入我们的社团吗?

questions.prompt: 「我想买一本新词典。」的正确英文是?
options: I want to buying a new dictionary.
I want buy a new dictionary.
I want buying a new dictionary.
I want to buy a new dictionary.
questions.explanation: 考查want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。正确句:I want to buy a new dictionary.

questions.prompt: She decided _____ English by herself.
options: to learning
learn
learning
to learn
questions.explanation: 考查want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。此处应为 to learn。句意:她决定自学英语。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We hope to visiting Xi'an next year.
We hope to visit Xi'an next year.
We hope visiting Xi'an next year.
We hope visit Xi'an next year.
questions.explanation: want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。正确句:We hope to visit Xi'an next year.

questions.prompt: 「他们计划建一个小花园。」的正确英文是?
options: They plan to build a small garden.
They plan building a small garden.
They plan to building a small garden.
They plan build a small garden.
questions.explanation: 考查want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。正确句:They plan to build a small garden.

questions.prompt: He promised _____ me with art.
options: helping
help
to help
to helping
questions.explanation: 考查want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。此处应为 to help。句意:他答应帮我学美术。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Would you like joining our club?
Would you like to join our club?
Would you like to joining our club?
Would you like join our club?
questions.explanation: want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。正确句:Would you like to join our club?

title: Gerunds as object enjoy doing · 情景运用(第4轮)
summary: Verbs like enjoy, finish, practice, mind, keep are followed by the gerund as object.本课为情景运用练习,核心:enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。
points: enjoy doing = enjoy something
finish doing = finish doing something
practice doing / keep doing
mind doing (used in questions)
stop doing stops the current action; stop to do stops in order to do something else

examples.en: I enjoy reading books about art.
examples.zh: 我喜欢读关于美术的书。

examples.en: She finished writing the letter at ten.
examples.zh: 她十点写完了信。

examples.en: We practice speaking English every morning.
examples.zh: 我们每天早上练习说英语。

examples.en: Would you mind opening the window?
examples.zh: 你介意打开窗户吗?

examples.en: He keeps doing exercise to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 他坚持锻炼以保持健康。

examples.en: They stopped talking when the teacher came in.
examples.zh: 老师进来时他们停止了交谈。

questions.prompt: I enjoy _____ books about art.
options: read
to read
reading
to reading
questions.explanation: 考查enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。此处应为 reading。句意:我喜欢读关于美术的书。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She finished write the letter at ten.
She finished writing the letter at ten.
She finished to write the letter at ten.
She finished to writing the letter at ten.
questions.explanation: enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。正确句:She finished writing the letter at ten.

questions.prompt: 「我们每天早上练习说英语。」的正确英文是?
options: We practice to speaking English every morning.
We practice speaking English every morning.
We practice to speak English every morning.
We practice speak English every morning.
questions.explanation: 考查enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。正确句:We practice speaking English every morning.

questions.prompt: Would you mind _____ the window?
options: to open
to opening
open
opening
questions.explanation: 考查enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。此处应为 opening。句意:你介意打开窗户吗?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He keeps doing exercise to stay healthy.
He keeps to doing exercise to stay healthy.
He keeps to do exercise to stay healthy.
He keeps do exercise to stay healthy.
questions.explanation: enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。正确句:He keeps doing exercise to stay healthy.

questions.prompt: 「老师进来时他们停止了交谈。」的正确英文是?
options: They stopped talking when the teacher came in.
They stopped to talk when the teacher came in.
They stopped to talking when the teacher came in.
They stopped talk when the teacher came in.
questions.explanation: 考查enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。正确句:They stopped talking when the teacher came in.

title: Gerunds after prepositions · 情景运用(第4轮)
summary: A verb after a preposition takes the gerund: at/in/on/of/for/about + V-ing.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。
points: be good at + V-ing
be interested in + V-ing
instead of + V-ing
look forward to + V-ing (to is a preposition)
before/after + V-ing as object

examples.en: She is good at drawing pictures.
examples.zh: 她擅长画画。

examples.en: I am interested in learning history.
examples.zh: 我对学历史感兴趣。

examples.en: He went out instead of doing homework.
examples.zh: 他没有做作业,而是出去了。

examples.en: We look forward to seeing you again.
examples.zh: 我们期待再见到你。

examples.en: Wash your hands before eating.
examples.zh: 饭前要洗手。

examples.en: Thank you for helping me with the work.
examples.zh: 谢谢你帮我做这项工作。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She is good at drawing pictures.
She is good at to draw pictures.
She is good at draw pictures.
She is good at draws pictures.
questions.explanation: Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:She is good at drawing pictures.

questions.prompt: 「我对学历史感兴趣。」的正确英文是?
options: I am interested in learns history.
I am interested in to learn history.
I am interested in learning history.
I am interested in learn history.
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:I am interested in learning history.

questions.prompt: He went out instead of _____ homework.
options: doing
to do
do
does
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。此处应为 doing。句意:他没有做作业,而是出去了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We look forward to to see you again.
We look forward to see you again.
We look forward to sees you again.
We look forward to seeing you again.
questions.explanation: Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:We look forward to seeing you again.

questions.prompt: 「饭前要洗手。」的正确英文是?
options: Wash your hands before to eat.
Wash your hands before eats.
Wash your hands before eat.
Wash your hands before eating.
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:Wash your hands before eating.

questions.prompt: Thank you for _____ me with the work.
options: help
helping
helps
to help
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。此处应为 helping。句意:谢谢你帮我做这项工作。

title: so...that / too...to / enough to · 情景运用(第4轮)
summary: Three result structures: so...that, too...to (negative meaning), enough to (affirmative meaning).本课为情景运用练习,核心:so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。
points: so + adjective/adorb + that clause
too + adjective + to do = too...to
adjective + enough + to do = enough to...
so that can also express purpose
such + noun phrase + that, distinguished from so

examples.en: The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.
examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了,我搬不动。

examples.en: He is too young to drive a car.
examples.zh: 他太年轻,不能开车。

examples.en: She is old enough to go to school.
examples.zh: 她到上学的年龄了。

examples.en: The question was so difficult that nobody answered it.
examples.zh: 这道题太难了,没人答出来。

examples.en: It is such an interesting book that I read it twice.
examples.zh: 这本书如此有趣,我读了两遍。

examples.en: He ran fast enough to catch the bus.
examples.zh: 他跑得够快,赶上了公交车。

questions.prompt: 「这个箱子太重了,我搬不动。」的正确英文是?
options: The box is such heavy that I can't carry it.
The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.
The box is too heavy that that I can't carry it.
The box is heavy so that I can't carry it.
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.

questions.prompt: He is _____ to drive a car.
options: such young
so young
too young
young enough
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。此处应为 too young。句意:他太年轻,不能开车。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She is enough old to go to school.
She is old enough to go to school.
She is too old to go to school.
She is so old to go to school.
questions.explanation: so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:She is old enough to go to school.

questions.prompt: 「这道题太难了,没人答出来。」的正确英文是?
options: The question was such difficult that nobody answered it.
The question was so difficult that nobody answered it.
The question was difficult so that nobody answered it.
The question was too difficult that that nobody answered it.
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:The question was so difficult that nobody answered it.

questions.prompt: It is _____ an interesting book that I read it twice.
options: such
too
so
very
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。此处应为 such。句意:这本书如此有趣,我读了两遍。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He ran so fast to catch the bus.
He ran too fast to catch the bus.
He ran fast enough to catch the bus.
He ran enough fast to catch the bus.
questions.explanation: so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。正确句:He ran fast enough to catch the bus.

title: Tag questions · 情景运用(第4轮)
summary: Tag questions: front affirmative, tag negative, and vice versa; reuse the be/auxiliary/modal of the main clause.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。
points: front affirmative, tag negative
front negative, tag affirmative
the tag uses the be/auxiliary/modal of the main clause
Let's..., shall we?
an imperative sentence uses will you

examples.en: You are a student, aren't you?
examples.zh: 你是学生,不是吗?

examples.en: She doesn't like bread, does she?
examples.zh: 她不喜欢面包,对吗?

examples.en: They went to the gym yesterday, didn't they?
examples.zh: 他们昨天去了健身房,不是吗?

examples.en: He can swim well, can't he?
examples.zh: 他游泳游得很好,不是吗?

examples.en: Let's take a walk after dinner, shall we?
examples.zh: 晚饭后我们散散步,好吗?

examples.en: Close the door, will you?
examples.zh: 把门关上,好吗?

questions.prompt: You are a student, _____?
options: aren't you
isn't you
are you
don't you
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。此处应为 aren't you。句意:你是学生,不是吗?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She doesn't like bread, is she?
She doesn't like bread, doesn't she?
She doesn't like bread, does she?
She doesn't like bread, did she?
questions.explanation: Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:She doesn't like bread, does she?

questions.prompt: 「他们昨天去了健身房,不是吗?」的正确英文是?
options: They went to the gym yesterday, didn't they?
They went to the gym yesterday, weren't they?
They went to the gym yesterday, did they?
They went to the gym yesterday, don't they?
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:They went to the gym yesterday, didn't they?

questions.prompt: He can swim well, _____?
options: can he
can't he
isn't he
does he
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。此处应为 can't he。句意:他游泳游得很好,不是吗?

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Let's take a walk after dinner, do we?
Let's take a walk after dinner, shant we?
Let's take a walk after dinner, shall we?
Let's take a walk after dinner, will we?
questions.explanation: Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:Let's take a walk after dinner, shall we?

questions.prompt: 「把门关上,好吗?」的正确英文是?
options: Close the door, will you?
Close the door, do you?
Close the door, won't I?
Close the door, shall you?
questions.explanation: 考查Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。正确句:Close the door, will you?

title: Exclamatory sentences What / How · 情景运用(第4轮)
summary: Exclamatory sentences start with What or How: What a/an + adjective + singular noun; How + adjective.本课为情景运用练习,核心:What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。
points: What a/an + adjective + singular noun
What + adjective + plural noun
How + adjective/adorb + subject + verb
the exclamatory word must be placed before the phrase it modifies
an exclamatory sentence can omit the subject and verb

examples.en: What a beautiful day it is!
examples.zh: 多么美好的一天啊!

examples.en: What lovely flowers they are!
examples.zh: 多么可爱的花啊!

examples.en: How fast he runs!
examples.zh: 他跑得真快!

examples.en: What an interesting book this is!
examples.zh: 这是一本多么有趣的书啊!

examples.en: How time flies!
examples.zh: 时间过得多快啊!

examples.en: What good news it is!
examples.zh: 多么好的消息啊!

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: What beautiful day it is!
How a beautiful day it is!
How beautiful day it is!
What a beautiful day it is!
questions.explanation: What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:What a beautiful day it is!

questions.prompt: 「多么可爱的花啊!」的正确英文是?
options: What a lovely flowers they are!
How lovely flowers they are!
What lovely flowers they are!
How a lovely flowers they are!
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:What lovely flowers they are!

questions.prompt: _____ fast he runs!
options: How
So
What
What a
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。此处应为 How。句意:他跑得真快!

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: What a interesting book this is!
How interesting book this is!
So an interesting book this is!
What an interesting book this is!
questions.explanation: What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:What an interesting book this is!

questions.prompt: 「时间过得多快啊!」的正确英文是?
options: What time flies!
How time flies!
What a time flies!
So time flies!
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。正确句:How time flies!

questions.prompt: _____ good news it is!
options: What
How
How a
What a
questions.explanation: 考查What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。此处应为 What。句意:多么好的消息啊!

title: both / either / neither · 情景运用(第4轮)
summary: both/either/neither express the quantity relationships of two objects; mind singular and plural agreement.本课为情景运用练习,核心:both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。
points: both...and... connects two parallel parts
neither...nor... neither...nor...
either...or... either...or...
both of them are / neither of them is
the subject connected by either...or agrees with the nearer one (proximity principle)

examples.en: Both of my parents like traveling.
examples.zh: 我的父母都喜欢旅行。

examples.en: Neither of the answers is right.
examples.zh: 两个答案都不对。

examples.en: You can take either of the two books.
examples.zh: 这两本书你可以拿任意一本。

examples.en: Neither Tom nor his sister was at home.
examples.zh: 汤姆和他妹妹都不在家。

examples.en: Both Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
examples.zh: 莉莉和汤姆都在二班。

examples.en: Either you or he has to clean the classroom.
examples.zh: 要么你要么他得打扫教室。

questions.prompt: 「我的父母都喜欢旅行。」的正确英文是?
options: Neither of my parents like traveling.
All of my parents like traveling.
Both of my parents like traveling.
Either of my parents like traveling.
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Both of my parents like traveling.

questions.prompt: Neither of the answers _____ right.
options: are
were

examples.zh: 我必须在他回来前完成工作。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?

I will call you when I am getting home.
I will call you when I will get home.
I will call you when I got home.
questions.explanation: The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。正确句:I will call you when I get home.

questions.prompt: 「离开前关灯。」的正确英文是?
options: Turn off the lights before you are leaving.
Turn off the lights before you will leave.
Turn off the lights before you left.
Turn off the lights before you leave.
questions.explanation: 考查The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。正确句:Turn off the lights before you leave.

questions.prompt: After she _____ her homework, she watches TV.

finished
finishes
will finish

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: As soon as the rain stopped, we will go out.
As soon as the rain will stop, we will go out.
As soon as the rain is stopping, we will go out.
As soon as the rain stops, we will go out.

questions.prompt: 「春天来临时花就开了。」的正确英文是?
options: When spring will come, the flowers come out.
When spring comes, the flowers come out.

When spring is coming, the flowers come out.

came back
comes back
will come back
questions.explanation: 考查The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。此处应为 comes back。句意:我必须在他回来前完成工作。

title: First conditional if...will · 专项练习(第4轮)
summary: First conditional: if + present, main clause will + base verb, expressing a real future possibility.本课为专项练习练习,核心:If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。
points: if + subject + present
main clause subject + will + base verb
the subordinate clause cannot use will
the if clause can come before or after
unless = if...not

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨,我们就待在家里。

examples.en: We will miss the train if we are late.
examples.zh: 如果迟到我们就赶不上火车了。

examples.en: If you work hard, you will pass the exam.
examples.zh: 如果你努力学习,就会通过考试。

examples.en: She will help you if you ask her.
examples.zh: 如果你请她帮忙,她会帮你。

examples.en: If we plant more trees, the city will be greener.
examples.zh: 如果我们种更多的树,城市会更绿。

examples.en: You will feel better if you take a rest.
examples.zh: 如果你休息一下,会感觉好一些。

questions.prompt: 「如果明天下雨,我们就待在家里。」的正确英文是?
options: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If it rained tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If it is raining tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.explanation: 考查If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。正确句:If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

questions.prompt: We will miss the train if we _____ late.
options: would be
are
were
will be
questions.explanation: 考查If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。此处应为 are。句意:如果迟到我们就赶不上火车了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If you work hard, you passed the exam.
If you work hard, you would pass the exam.
If you work hard, you will pass the exam.
If you work hard, you pass the exam.
questions.explanation: If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。正确句:If you work hard, you will pass the exam.

questions.prompt: 「如果你请她帮忙,她会帮你。」的正确英文是?
options: She will help you if you would ask her.
She will help you if you will ask her.
She will help you if you ask her.
She will help you if you asked her.
questions.explanation: 考查If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。正确句:She will help you if you ask her.

questions.prompt: If we _____ more trees, the city will be greener.
options: planted
would plant
plant
will plant
questions.explanation: 考查If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。此处应为 plant。句意:如果我们种更多的树,城市会更绿。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: You will feel better if you would take a rest.
You will feel better if you take a rest.
You will feel better if you took a rest.
You will feel better if you will take a rest.
questions.explanation: If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。正确句:You will feel better if you take a rest.

title: Adverbial clauses of reason with because / since / as · 专项练习(第4轮)
summary: Reason adverbial clauses: because is strongest, since/as introduce reasons both sides already know.本课为专项练习练习,核心:because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。
points: because answers why, strongest tone
since = since, based on a known fact
as = as, weakest tone
now that = since
when because is used, so is not used in the main clause

examples.en: Since everyone is here, let's begin the class.
examples.zh: 既然大家都到了,我们开始上课吧。

examples.en: He didn't go to school because he was ill.
examples.zh: 他因为生病没去上学。

examples.en: As it is late, we'd better take a taxi.
examples.zh: 由于天晚了,我们最好打车。

examples.en: Now that the work is done, you can rest.
examples.zh: 既然工作做完了,你可以休息了。

examples.en: I stayed because the meeting was long.
examples.zh: 因为会议很长,我留下来了。

examples.en: Since you know the answer, please tell us.
examples.zh: 既然你知道答案,请告诉我们。

questions.prompt: _____ everyone is here, let's begin the class.
options: Since
Because of
For that
As for
questions.explanation: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。此处应为 Since。句意:既然大家都到了,我们开始上课吧。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He didn't go to school because of he was ill.
He didn't go to school because he was ill.
He didn't go to school as for he was ill.
He didn't go to school so he was ill.
questions.explanation: because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:He didn't go to school because he was ill.

questions.prompt: 「由于天晚了,我们最好打车。」的正确英文是?
options: For it is late, we'd better take a taxi.
Because of it is late, we'd better take a taxi.
As it is late, we'd better take a taxi.
Since that it is late, we'd better take a taxi.
questions.explanation: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:As it is late, we'd better take a taxi.

questions.prompt: _____ the work is done, you can rest.
options: For now
Because of
Now that
Now what
questions.explanation: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。此处应为 Now that。句意:既然工作做完了,你可以休息了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I stayed because the meeting was long.
I stayed so the meeting was long.
I stayed because of the meeting was long.
I stayed due the meeting was long.
questions.explanation: because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:I stayed because the meeting was long.

questions.prompt: 「既然你知道答案,请告诉我们。」的正确英文是?
options: Since you know the answer, please tell us.
So you know the answer, please tell us.
For you know the answer, please tell us.
Because of you know the answer, please tell us.
questions.explanation: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:Since you know the answer, please tell us.

title: Adverbial clauses of concession with although / though · 专项练习(第4轮)
summary: although/though introduces a concession: cannot be used together with but.本课为专项练习练习,核心:although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。
points: although = though, placed at the start
the main clause cannot use but, but can use yet/still
even though has a stronger tone
though can appear at the end of a sentence
despite/in spite of + noun also express concession

examples.en: Although it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
examples.zh: 虽然天很冷,我们旅行得很愉快。

examples.en: Though he is young, he knows a lot.
examples.zh: 虽然他年纪小,但懂得很多。

examples.en: Although she was tired, she kept working.
examples.zh: 虽然她很累,仍继续工作。

examples.en: Even though the task was hard, we finished it.
examples.zh: 尽管任务很难,我们还是完成了。

examples.en: He passed the exam though he was ill.
examples.zh: 虽然生病了,他还是通过了考试。

examples.en: Although the shop is small, it has everything.
examples.zh: 这家店虽然小,但什么都有。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Despite it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
Although it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
Even it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
Although but it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.
questions.explanation: although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Although it was cold, we enjoyed the trip.

options: Despite he is young, he knows a lot.

Though he is young, he knows a lot.
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Though he is young, he knows a lot.

options: keeps

kept
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。此处应为 kept。句意:虽然她很累,仍继续工作。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Despite the task was hard, we finished it.
Even though the task was hard, we finished it.
Although but the task was hard, we finished it.
Even the task was hard, we finished it.
questions.explanation: although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:Even though the task was hard, we finished it.

questions.prompt: 「虽然生病了,他还是通过了考试。」的正确英文是?
options: He passed the exam though he was ill.
He passed the exam however he was ill.
He passed the exam despite he was ill.
He passed the exam but he was ill.
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。正确句:He passed the exam though he was ill.

questions.prompt: _____ the shop is small, it has everything.
options: Although
Despite
However
Although but
questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。此处应为 Although。句意:这家店虽然小,但什么都有。

title: Adverbials of purpose with to / in order to · 专项练习(第4轮)
summary: Adverbials of purpose express purpose: to/in order to + base verb, so that + clause.本课为专项练习练习,核心:to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。
points: to + base verb is the most common
in order to emphasizes purpose
so as to / in order to can be placed at the start
so that + subject + can/may + base verb
in order not to / so as not to express a negative purpose

examples.en: I got up early to catch the first bus.
examples.zh: 我早起是为了赶上头班车。

examples.en: She studies hard in order to go to college.
examples.zh: 她努力学习是为了上大学。

examples.en: We speak slowly so that everyone can follow.
examples.zh: 我们说得慢,好让每个人都能跟上。

examples.en: He saved money to buy a new bike.
examples.zh: 他攒钱是为了买一辆新自行车。

examples.en: I wrote it down in order not to forget.
examples.zh: 我记下来是为了不忘记。

examples.en: They plant trees to make the city greener.
examples.zh: 他们种树是为了让城市更绿。

questions.prompt: 「我早起是为了赶上头班车。」的正确英文是?
options: I got up early to catching the first bus.
I got up early for catch the first bus.
I got up early to catch the first bus.
I got up early catch the first bus.
questions.explanation: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:I got up early to catch the first bus.

questions.prompt: She studies hard _____ go to college.
options: in order to
in order that to
for
so as
questions.explanation: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。此处应为 in order to。句意:她努力学习是为了上大学。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?

We speak slowly so as everyone can follow.
We speak slowly in order everyone can follow.
We speak slowly because everyone can follow.
questions.explanation: to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:We speak slowly so that everyone can follow.

questions.prompt: 「他攒钱是为了买一辆新自行车。」的正确英文是?
options: He saved money for buy a new bike.
He saved money to buy a new bike.
He saved money to buying a new bike.
He saved money buy a new bike.
questions.explanation: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:He saved money to buy a new bike.

questions.prompt: I wrote it down _____ forget.
options: for not
in order not to
in order to not
so that not to
questions.explanation: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。此处应为 in order not to。句意:我记下来是为了不忘记。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: They plant trees to make the city greener.
They plant trees to making the city greener.
They plant trees for make the city greener.
They plant trees make the city greener.
questions.explanation: to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:They plant trees to make the city greener.

title: Infinitives as object want to do · 专项练习(第4轮)
summary: Verbs like want, decide, hope, plan, promise are followed by the infinitive as object.本课为专项练习练习,核心:want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。
points: want to do = want to do something
decide to do = decide to do something
hope to do / plan to do / agree to do
would like to do expresses a polite wish
enjoy/finish/mind take V-ing instead

examples.en: I want to buy a new dictionary.
examples.zh: 我想买一本新词典。

examples.en: She decided to learn history by herself.
examples.zh: 她决定自学历史。

examples.en: We hope to visit Xi'an next year.
examples.zh: 我们希望明年去西安。

options: to buy
buy
buying
to buying
questions.explanation: 考查want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。此处应为 to buy。句意:我想买一本新词典。

options: She decided to learning history by herself.
She decided learning history by herself.

questions.explanation: want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。正确句:She decided to learn history by herself.

options: We hope visit Xi'an next year.
We hope to visiting Xi'an next year.

We hope to visit Xi'an next year.
questions.explanation: 考查want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。正确句:We hope to visit Xi'an next year.

questions.prompt: They plan _____ a small garden.
options: building
to build
to building
build
questions.explanation: 考查want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。此处应为 to build。句意:他们计划建一个小花园。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He promised to help me with math.
He promised helping me with math.
He promised help me with math.
He promised to helping me with math.
questions.explanation: want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。正确句:He promised to help me with math.

questions.prompt: 「你愿意加入我们的社团吗?」的正确英文是?
options: Would you like joining our club?
Would you like join our club?
Would you like to joining our club?
Would you like to join our club?
questions.explanation: 考查want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。正确句:Would you like to join our club?

title: Gerunds as object enjoy doing · 专项练习(第4轮)
summary: Verbs like enjoy, finish, practice, mind, keep are followed by the gerund as object.本课为专项练习练习,核心:enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。
points: enjoy doing = enjoy something
finish doing = finish doing something
practice doing / keep doing
mind doing (used in questions)
stop doing stops the current action; stop to do stops in order to do something else

examples.en: I enjoy reading books about English.
examples.zh: 我喜欢读关于英语的书。

examples.en: She finished writing the letter at ten.
examples.zh: 她十点写完了信。

examples.en: We practice speaking English every morning.
examples.zh: 我们每天早上练习说英语。

examples.en: Would you mind opening the window?

examples.en: He keeps doing exercise to stay healthy.

options: I enjoy to reading books about English.
I enjoy reading books about English.

She finished writing the letter at ten.

questions.explanation: 考查enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。正确句:She finished writing the letter at ten.

questions.prompt: We practice _____ English every morning.
options: to speaking
speaking
to speak
speak
questions.explanation: 考查enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。此处应为 speaking。句意:我们每天早上练习说英语。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Would you mind to opening the window?
Would you mind opening the window?
Would you mind open the window?
Would you mind to open the window?
questions.explanation: enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。正确句:Would you mind opening the window?

questions.prompt: 「他坚持锻炼以保持健康。」的正确英文是?
options: He keeps to doing exercise to stay healthy.
He keeps do exercise to stay healthy.
He keeps doing exercise to stay healthy.
He keeps to do exercise to stay healthy.
questions.explanation: 考查enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。正确句:He keeps doing exercise to stay healthy.

questions.prompt: They stopped _____ when the teacher came in.
options: talk
to talking
to talk
talking
questions.explanation: 考查enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。此处应为 talking。句意:老师进来时他们停止了交谈。

title: Gerunds after prepositions · 专项练习(第4轮)

be interested in + V-ing
instead of + V-ing
look forward to + V-ing (to is a preposition)
before/after + V-ing as object

examples.zh: 我对学英语感兴趣。

examples.zh: 他没有做作业,而是出去了。

examples.en: We look forward to seeing you again.

examples.en: Thank you for helping me with the work.
examples.zh: 谢谢你帮我做这项工作。

questions.prompt: 「她擅长画画。」的正确英文是?
options: She is good at to draw pictures.
She is good at draw pictures.
She is good at draws pictures.
She is good at drawing pictures.
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:She is good at drawing pictures.

questions.prompt: I am interested in _____ English.
options: learns
to learn
learning
learn
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。此处应为 learning。句意:我对学英语感兴趣。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?

questions.explanation: Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:He went out instead of doing homework.

questions.prompt: 「我们期待再见到你。」的正确英文是?
options: We look forward to to see you again.

We look forward to seeing you again.
We look forward to see you again.
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。正确句:We look forward to seeing you again.

questions.prompt: Wash your hands before _____.
options: eating
eats
to eat
eat
questions.explanation: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。此处应为 eating。句意:饭前要洗手。

title: so...that / too...to / enough to · 专项练习(第4轮)
summary: Three result structures: so...that, too...to (negative meaning), enough to (affirmative meaning).本课为专项练习练习,核心:so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。

too + adjective + to do = too...to

so that can also express purpose
such + noun phrase + that, distinguished from so

examples.en: He ran fast enough to catch the bus.
examples.zh: 他跑得够快,赶上了公交车。

questions.prompt: The box is _____ that I can't carry it.
options: too heavy that
so heavy
heavy so
such heavy
questions.explanation: 考查so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。此处应为 so heavy。句意:这个箱子太重了,我搬不动。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?

options: Summer is the season which we swim a lot.

Summer is the season when we swim a lot.

why

options: The city which they live is very quiet.
The city when they live is very quiet.

The city where they live is very quiet.
questions.explanation: where modifies a place, when modifies a time, acting as an adverbial inside the clause。正确句:The city where they live is very quiet.

title: Object clauses with that · 综合测试(第4轮)
summary: An object clause serves as the object of a verb like say/think/know/believe; the word order must be statement order.本课为综合测试练习,核心:that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。
points: that can be omitted
the object clause must use statement word order: I think that he is right
the negative transfer of think: I don't think he is right
the tense follows the main clause
when the main clause is in the past, the clause moves back one tense

examples.en: I think that the movie is wonderful.
examples.zh: 我觉得这部电影很精彩。

examples.en: She said that she would come the next day.
examples.zh: 她说她第二天会来。

examples.en: We know that the earth goes around the sun.
examples.zh: 我们知道地球绕着太阳转。

examples.en: He believes that practice makes perfect.
examples.zh: 他相信熟能生巧。

examples.en: I don't think that he is right.
examples.zh: 我认为他不对。

examples.en: The teacher said that light travels faster than sound.
examples.zh: 老师说光比声音传播得快。

questions.prompt: I think that the movie _____ wonderful.
options: does
is
be
are
questions.explanation: 考查that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。此处应为 is。句意:我觉得这部电影很精彩。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She said that she will come the next day.
She said that she comes the next day.
She said that she would come the next day.
She said that she would came the next day.
questions.explanation: that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。正确句:She said that she would come the next day.

questions.prompt: 「我们知道地球绕着太阳转。」的正确英文是?
options: We know that the earth goes around the sun.
We know that the earth does go around the sun.
We know that the earth went around the sun.
We know that the earth go around the sun.
questions.explanation: 考查that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。正确句:We know that the earth goes around the sun.

questions.prompt: He believes that practice _____ perfect.
options: make
makes
does make
made
questions.explanation: 考查that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。此处应为 makes。句意:他相信熟能生巧。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I don't think that he is right.
I don't think that he right is.
I don't think that he does right.
I don't think that is he right.
questions.explanation: that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。正确句:I don't think that he is right.

questions.prompt: 「老师说光比声音传播得快。」的正确英文是?
options: The teacher said that light does travel faster than sound.
The teacher said that light travel faster than sound.
The teacher said that light travelled faster than sound.
The teacher said that light travels faster than sound.
questions.explanation: 考查that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。正确句:The teacher said that light travels faster than sound.

title: Object clauses with if / whether and question words · 综合测试(第4轮)
summary: if/whether and special question words introduce object clauses; the key exam point is word order.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。
points: if/whether means 'whether'
special question words (what/where/when/how) keep their original meaning
the clause uses statement word order: where he lives
the tense follows the main clause
the expression for polite requests: Could you tell me how to get to...

examples.en: I don't know whether he will come.
examples.zh: 我不知道他是否会来。

examples.en: Do you know where the station is?
examples.zh: 你知道车站在哪儿吗?

examples.en: She asked what time it was.
examples.zh: 她问现在几点了。

examples.en: Nobody knows why he left so early.
examples.zh: 没人知道他为什么走这么早。

examples.en: Could you tell me how I can get to the gym?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我怎么去健身房吗?

examples.en: I wonder if the shop is open now.
examples.zh: 我想知道商店现在是否开门。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I don't know whether he comes will.
I don't know whether he will come.
I don't know whether will he come.
I don't know whether does he come.
questions.explanation: Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。正确句:I don't know whether he will come.

questions.prompt: 「你知道车站在哪儿吗?」的正确英文是?
options: Do you know where does the station?
Do you know where the station is?
Do you know where the station does?
Do you know where is the station?
questions.explanation: 考查Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。正确句:Do you know where the station is?

questions.prompt: She asked _____.
options: what time was it
it was what time
what is time it
what time it was
questions.explanation: 考查Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。此处应为 what time it was。句意:她问现在几点了。

Could you tell me how do I get to the gym?
questions.explanation: 考查Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。正确句:Could you tell me how I can get to the gym?

if is the shop
the shop if is
if does the shop
questions.explanation: 考查Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。此处应为 if the shop is。句意:我想知道商店现在是否开门。

title: Adverbial clauses of time with when / before / after · 综合测试(第4轮)
summary: A time adverbial clause introduced by when/before/after/as soon as; the future is expressed with the present.本课为综合测试练习,核心:The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。
points: when + point in time
before = before, after = after
main clause future, subordinate clause present
as soon as = as soon as
while + continuous action

examples.en: I will call you when I get home.
examples.zh: 我到家后会给你打电话。

examples.en: Turn off the lights before you leave.
examples.zh: 离开前关灯。

examples.en: After she finishes her homework, she watches TV.
examples.zh: 她做完作业后看电视。

examples.en: As soon as the rain stops, we will go out.
examples.zh: 雨一停我们就出去。

examples.en: When spring comes, the flowers come out.
examples.zh: 春天来临时花就开了。

examples.en: I must finish the work before he comes back.
examples.zh: 我必须在他回来前完成工作。

questions.prompt: 「我到家后会给你打电话。」的正确英文是?
options: I will call you when I get home.
I will call you when I got home.
I will call you when I will get home.
I will call you when I am getting home.
questions.explanation: 考查The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。正确句:I will call you when I get home.

questions.prompt: Turn off the lights before you _____.
options: are leaving
will leave
left
leave
questions.explanation: 考查The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。此处应为 leave。句意:离开前关灯。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: After she finishes her homework, she watches TV.
After she is finishing her homework, she watches TV.
After she finished her homework, she watches TV.
After she will finish her homework, she watches TV.
questions.explanation: The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。正确句:After she finishes her homework, she watches TV.

questions.prompt: 「雨一停我们就出去。」的正确英文是?
options: As soon as the rain stops, we will go out.
As soon as the rain stopped, we will go out.

As soon as the rain is stopping, we will go out.
questions.explanation: 考查The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。正确句:As soon as the rain stops, we will go out.

I must finish the work before he will come back.
I must finish the work before he comes back.
I must finish the work before he came back.
questions.explanation: The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。正确句:I must finish the work before he comes back.

title: First conditional if...will · 综合测试(第4轮)
summary: First conditional: if + present, main clause will + base verb, expressing a real future possibility.本课为综合测试练习,核心:If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。
points: if + subject + present
main clause subject + will + base verb
the subordinate clause cannot use will
the if clause can come before or after
unless = if...not

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨,我们就待在家里。

examples.en: We will miss the train if we are late.
examples.zh: 如果迟到我们就赶不上火车了。

examples.en: If you work hard, you will pass the exam.
examples.zh: 如果你努力学习,就会通过考试。

examples.en: She will help you if you ask her.
examples.zh: 如果你请她帮忙,她会帮你。

examples.en: You will feel better if you take a rest.

will rain
rained
rains

options: If you work hard, you will pass the exam.

If you work hard, you pass the exam.

options: would ask

ask
